claims: Generation Z refers to people born between 1997 and 2012.
In 2026, Generation Z is approximately 14 to 29 years old.
1997–2012 is the most widely accepted range for Generation Z used by researchers such as Pew Research Center.
Some sources suggest a range for Generation Z starting in 1996.
Some sources suggest a range for Generation Z ending later than 2012.
The 1997–2012 timeframe is the standard for Generation Z.
Generation Alpha is roughly 2013 to mid-2020s.
Generation Z is the first generation to grow up with social media and smartphones as a commonplace technology from a young age.
Generation Z grew up with high-speed internet and smartphones.
